text:
marie: quick async standup — api-gateway/routing policy update: pushed PR #3421 to staging. observed a short 429 spike during internal loadtest at ~09:14, likely due to burst config + small autoscale window. blocked on adding token-rotate smoke test to staging before we can promote to canary. pinging @alex for auth config question.

alex: got it — which tenant did the loadtest hit? can you paste the staging logs snippet? I can also check the auth cache TTLs.

marie: load test tenant: internal-loadtest-3. logs (truncated):
```
2024-11-05T09:14:02Z gw-proxy-5c8f kernel: connection reset by peer: tenant=internal-loadtest-3 route=/v1/generate status=429 burst=120/100
2024-11-05T09:14:03Z gw-proxy-5c8f rate-limiter: token-bucket drop tenant=internal-loadtest-3 tokens=0
```
Looks like burst cap (120) was briefly > provisioned tokens (100) after a traffic ramp.

jamal: I skimmed PR #3421 — logic looks fine but we should tighten the default burst for non-prod tenants. I'll open a small follow-up to set burst=80 in staging and add a comment explaining it. lgtm otherwise.

tess: I can take the token-rotate smoke test work today. quick question: do we want the smoke to be an end-to-end call hitting the auth service + gateway, or just a unit of the key rotation job? e2e would catch mismatches but takes longer to run.

marie: thanks @tess — prefer e2e in staging but keep it lightweight (single token exchange + short TTL rotation). If that's heavy, we can gate it behind a nightly job first.

alex: I checked auth cache TTLs — the service caches jwk keys for 30s by default in staging env. If rotation happens faster, that could cause 401s but not 429s. For the 429s, looks like burst config + router warmup. I'll add a short script to warm connections before the loadtest.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued: PR #3421 -> canary/staging (by marie). Status: pending health checks.

marie: plan for today: (1) @tess add e2e token-rotate smoke (assign to you), (2) @jamal small PR to set staging burst=80, (3) @alex add warmup script and run another ramp test. I'll re-run the staging loadtest at 15:30 PT after changes.

alex: ack, will submit warmup script in a minute and kick a quick ramp once it's merged.

jamal: will open the burst tweak PR and tag @marie for quick review.

tess: starting smoke test work, will post updates and the test endpoint when ready. :thumbsup:

marie: thanks all — if anyone hits anything else in staging drop a short note here.

marie: also — small code review ping: @jamal pls review PR #3418 (gateway telemetry cleanup) when you have 10m, low-risk.

jamal: on it, thx.

marie: closing the loop — canary health checks passed after burst tweak, promoting later today if no regressions. :party_popper:
